ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from our department with specific attendance directives. NRES 403 section A will combine online lectures and computer lab sessions. All lectures will be recorded, so students can listen at their convenience. For labs, students are encouraged to use the workstations in M205 Turner Hall via VPN or in person, as long as the University allows in person class meetings. Dr. Hudson will generally be present for labs virtually, rather than in person. Students unable to enroll due to caps are encouraged to enroll in section XM1 and participate at their preferred time via Zoom. To request being added to the waiting list for this course, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
